name: netclip
description: LAN clipboard — Raycast-style clipboard history shared across your devices

scripts.build: npm --workspace web run build && node scripts/check-css.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/test-server.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3299 && node scripts/smoke.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3299 && node scripts/test-layout.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3299 --force
scripts.docker:run: docker run -d --name netclip -p 3210:3210 -v netclip-data:/data --restart unless-stopped netclip:latest
